matches.rationale: Finding 4 identifies the exact inconsistency described in gt_id 1: Section 4.2 claims the unified actor loss includes β_div·L_div and β_dyn·L_dyn terms, but Appendix I.2 Eq. (8) omits them. This directly detects the incomplete/inconsistent definition of the unified actor loss across sections.

None of the findings address the EDAC critic aggregation inconsistency (mean vs min) described in gt_id 2. The findings focus on other method logic issues but do not implicate the specific pseudocode discrepancy between EDAC's use of mean versus SAC-N/CQL's use of min for q_values.
